Professional Football Club Beroe Stara Zagora, better known as just Beroe, is a Bulgarian professional association football club based in Stara Zagora, that competes in the Second League, second division of the Bulgarian football league system. The club was founded in 1916 under the name Vereya. The club's colours are green and white.
